name: Simon & Marcy
description: The tragic backstory of Simon Petrikov, who found the Ice King's crown and slowly lost his sanity while caring for young Marceline during the aftermath of the Mushroom War. Their bond endures across centuries as Marceline watches her father figure fade into madness.

name: The Lich
description: An ancient undead being of pure evil created during the Mushroom War, the Lich seeks the extinction of all life. His schemes span dimensions and timelines, making him Adventure Time's most persistent existential threat. Though his physical form is transformed into Sweet P, the Lich's essence persists—reappearing in later incarnations including Fionna and Cake.

name: Finn the Human
description: Finn's journey to understand his origins as apparently the last human in Ooo. He discovers his father Martin, a deadbeat cosmic criminal, learns of his mother Minerva on a distant island of humans, and grapples with what it means to be a hero when your family disappoints you.

name: Bubbline
description: The complex romantic history between Princess Bubblegum and Marceline, spanning centuries from their early friendship through a painful breakup to eventual reconciliation. Their relationship develops from estranged exes to allies to partners by the series finale.

name: Stakes
description: Marceline's quest to become mortal again by having Princess Bubblegum extract her vampire essence. This releases the vampires she defeated centuries ago, forcing her to confront her past while her friends help her re-stake each vampire king and queen.

name: Elements
description: When the elemental powers of Ooo spiral out of control, the land is divided into four zones ruled by corrupted elementals. Finn must gather allies and restore balance as Patience St. Pim's scheme transforms everyone—including his friends—into elemental versions of themselves.

name: The Grass Sword & Fern
description: Finn's cursed grass sword merges with his arm and eventually creates Fern—a grass duplicate of Finn who struggles with his identity, jealousy, and the question of whether he's truly Finn or something else. His arc ends in tragic sacrifice during the finale.

name: The Gum War & GOLB
description: The series finale's climactic conflict: Princess Bubblegum's war with her Uncle Gumbald escalates until GOLB—a primordial deity of chaos and discord—is summoned. The resolution requires sacrifice, transformation, and brings closure to Simon's centuries-long search to save Betty.

name: Sweet P
description: After the Lich is reborn as a giant baby, Tree Trunks and Mr. Pig adopt him as their son Sweet P. He grows up kind and gentle, but the Lich occasionally tries to resurface, creating tension between his innocent nature and the evil lurking within.

name: Flame Princess
description: Flame Princess's journey from imprisoned daughter to righteous ruler of the Fire Kingdom. Her relationship with Finn teaches them both about honesty and boundaries, while her overthrow of her manipulative father shows her growing into a strong, independent leader.

name: The Lemongrabs
description: Princess Bubblegum's failed experiment Lemongrab and his clone spiral into tyranny over Castle Lemongrab. Their treatment of the lemon children, the liberation of Lemonhope, and the eventual merging of the two Lemongrabs explores themes of creation, responsibility, and dysfunction.

name: Peppermint Butler's Dark Side
description: Beneath his loyal butler exterior, Peppermint Butler harbors extensive knowledge of dark magic and connections to entities like Death and Hunson Abadeer. His occult interests culminate in Distant Lands where his dark side fully emerges.

name: Jake's Pups
description: Jake and Lady Rainicorn's five children rapidly age to adulthood and develop their own distinct personalities—from responsible Kim Kil Whan to laid-back T.V. to future-seeing Charlie. Their dynamics with Jake explore fatherhood and generational differences.

name: Prismo & the Cosmic
description: Prismo, the wish-granting entity in the Time Room, becomes one of Jake's closest friends. His death at the Lich's hands and eventual revival through Jake's dream self introduces the cosmic hierarchy including the Cosmic Owl and Party God.

name: Future Ooo
description: A thousand years after the main series, Shermy and Beth carry on the tradition of heroes in a transformed Ooo. Beth, a descendant of Jake's pups, mirrors his role while Shermy echoes Finn's adventurous spirit. Their era connects to expanded lore in Fionna and Cake.
